title: TransactionRequest
description: Request body of POST /v1/transactions (SDS §19.2, FR-M.2), reused transaction-by-transaction inside POST /v1/batches (FR-M.8) and as the base of POST /v1/issuances (FR-AE.2). Field names mirror canonical/openapi.yaml's RecordDocumentRequest/Party/Line/Totals one-for-one (canonical calls the parties object "parties"; this public resource calls it "counterparty", SDS §19.2's own term) so the two sides of the ingestion-svc -> canonical-svc sync edge never drift. entityRef is checked against the caller's token scope (API-24) rather than carried as a separate tenantId, since tenant and entity scope come from the token on the public surface.

sourceKey.description: Part of the idempotency pair (API-13, API-15, FR-M.3).

sourceRevision.description: Part of the idempotency pair (API-15, FR-M.3). Lower than already recorded is ING-002.

documentNumber.description: Required when documentFunction is BILL_FOR_PAYMENT (ING-009); otherwise omitted (API-14).

precedingDocumentNumber.description: Preceding Invoice Number (IBT-025): the number of the invoice a credit note corrects, where the original is known (INV-REQ-560). Optional; a number without precedingDocumentDate is valid, canonical-svc looks the original up or raises RUL-008 (INV-REQ-701). On a credit note with neither preceding field, precedingBlankJustification and evidenceRef are required (ING-019).

precedingDocumentDate.description: Preceding Invoice Date (IBT-026): the date of the invoice a credit note corrects, where the original is known (INV-REQ-560). The credit note resolves its rate and category code from this date (INV-REQ-701). On a credit note with neither preceding field, precedingBlankJustification and evidenceRef are required (ING-019).

precedingBlankJustification.description: Why a credit note leaves precedingDocumentNumber and precedingDocumentDate blank, e.g. a volume rebate not attributable to one invoice; notes that a rate-change straddle was considered (INV-REQ-561, INV-REQ-702). Required, together with evidenceRef, when documentFunction is CREDIT_NOTE and neither precedingDocumentNumber nor precedingDocumentDate is present; otherwise optional; refused with ING-019 (INV-REQ-561, INV-Q-1677, INV-Q-3450, INV-Q-3488). The condition is enforced by the receiving service, not by this schema (as documentNumber states ING-009).

evidenceRef.description: Reference to the business's other documentary evidence that GST was accounted for on the original supplies, for a blank-linked credit note (INV-REQ-561). Required, together with precedingBlankJustification, when documentFunction is CREDIT_NOTE and neither precedingDocumentNumber nor precedingDocumentDate is present; otherwise optional; refused with ING-019 (INV-REQ-561, INV-Q-1677, INV-Q-3450, INV-Q-3488). The condition is enforced by the receiving service, not by this schema (as documentNumber states ING-009).

unitPrice.description: Money as a decimal string, up to 6 places (API-12).

lineAmount.description: Money as a decimal string, decimal(19,2) (API-12).

taxAmount.description: Money as a decimal string, decimal(19,2) (API-12).
